reviewed_interpretation: Fresh I025 public-development evidence is valid and both the NS upstream mirror and VAD shipping mirror are exact. The authoritative populations contain 8,417 oracle-noise disagreement frames, 20,664 ordinary oracle-noise reference frames, and 8,655 oracle-speech disagreement frames. Variables that are partly defined by the selected population, especially disagreement_run_length and upstream_high_run_length, are treated only as persistence descriptions and not as causal source evidence. Among non-definition upstream component/state diagnostics, the strongest stable association with false-high noise is a sparser posterior shape: gap_to_concentration has global separability AUC 0.7540 with a seven-domain floor 0.7236; positive_bin_fraction is lower on disagreement-noise (median 0.2512 versus 0.4233 ordinary noise) and remains stable across domains. The gap appears to grow primarily because mean posterior activity is lower on disagreement-noise (mirror_mean median 0.1255 versus 0.2113), while concentration is only modestly higher (0.7731 versus 0.7451) and has weak noise-source cross-domain separation. The preregistered slow-noise-update self-lock hypothesis is not supported: slow_update_bin_fraction is lower on disagreement-noise (median 0.1395 versus 0.2419 ordinary noise), its three-frame mean is also lower, and mean_post_ratio is lower (1.2676 versus 1.7499). For disagreement speech versus disagreement noise, concentration_mean3, max_post_ratio and mirror_concentration retain moderate separation, confirming that useful upstream structure remains even though no mapping or component is selected. This reconciles with I014: concentration-minus-mean synergy can remain useful overall in nonstationary regimes while a sparse-posterior subset of oracle noise still produces false-high gap values. I025 therefore selects no component, weight, mapping, threshold, tracker alpha or source candidate. The next diagnostic may use fresh authority to perform a matched oracle-noise component counterfactual that independently replaces only mean or only concentration with same-case ordinary-noise references, using the unchanged 0.55 upstream guard solely as a causal readout.

disagreement_run_length.note: Tautological for noise_disagreement versus noise_reference because disagreement membership defines a positive run and reference frames are explicitly non-disagreement; not causal source evidence.

upstream_high_run_length.note: Strong persistence description but partly conditioned by population selection on upstream_probability > 0.55; not a component-cause selector.

hypothesis_review.explanation: False-high noise is associated with fewer active posterior bins and a larger concentration-minus-mean gap relative to concentration, while slow-update occupancy and mean post-ratio are lower rather than higher. The evidence supports sparse posterior gap formation as the next causal localization target but does not identify a shippable component rule.

proposed_followup_hypothesis.rationale: On entirely fresh public-development authority, construct same-case oracle-noise references from ordinary-noise frames and independently replace only the existing mirror mean or only the existing concentration when evaluating false-high disagreement-noise gap. Use the unchanged shipping upstream guard 0.55 only as a diagnostic readout of how often each replacement removes false-high status. Also report the same substitutions on disagreement-speech frames to expose whether a component is merely necessary for both classes. This localizes causal contribution without selecting a new mapping or source candidate.

verification_limits: I025 is candidate-zero and uses development-only oracle labels; AUCs and medians describe the constructed public-development distribution and are not calibrated product-environment rates.

The per-bin upstream internals are produced by a deterministic mirror tracker whose aggregate concentration-minus-mean gap exactly matches shipping NS speech_probability on the authoritative run; they remain diagnostic observations rather than a new runtime interface.
disagreement_run_length and upstream_high_run_length are conditioned by the population definition and must not be interpreted as independent causal source features.
Association of sparse posterior shape with false-high noise does not prove that changing mean, concentration, sparsity, tracker alpha or any mapping will improve shipping behavior.

The lower slow_update_bin_fraction and lower mean_post_ratio on false-high noise contradict the preregistered slow-update self-lock hypothesis under this authority, but do not prove tracker dynamics are irrelevant in every regime.

I014 remains authoritative that concentration-minus-mean synergy is useful overall in nonstationary regimes; I025 only localizes a false-high subset and does not authorize removal or reweighting of either component.
The artifact contains aggregate per-case/per-slice evidence and no raw audio archive.
